test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

53, 55, 58, 63, ?, 81
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**The numbers are increasing in Prime number order**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83b6e7bdab5a4c0172a9b5d4287147cd2d361069ea8d8b6e837e94ae5864baaf.png] 

So, '70' will replace the question mark in the series.

Hence, the correct answer is "70".
